channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Sons of immigrant killed by ICE in Texas share grief, demand accountability
item.description: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo's sons tell lawmakers their father worked hard 'to protect and provide' for his family.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition strikes Houthi-controlled Hodeidah
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition strikes targeted Houthi-controlled Hodeidah governorate.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says US ‘locked and loaded’ as it seeks Iran talks
item.description: US President Donald Trump says Washington remains ‘locked and loaded’ while pursuing diplomatic talks with Tehran.

item.title: Trump says ‘it’s time’ for Saudi Arabia to normalise ties with Israel
item.description: US president reiterates that the nuclear deal with the kingdom is conditioned on Riyadh joining the 'Abraham Accords'.

item.title: Iran’s Abbas Araghchi vows ‘we fear no one’
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Iran does not fear threats or 'succumb to pressures'.

item.title: Saudi Arabia strikes Houthi-held Hodeidah, Yemeni group says
item.description: Houthi-controlled Foreign Ministry warns that the attack will trigger further escalation in the Yemeni conflict.

item.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
item.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

item.title: US and Iran trade more strikes in Gulf as fears of escalation mount
item.description: It comes as Iran condemned the US plan to use frozen Iranian assets to pay for war damages.

item.title: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
item.description: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.

item.title: Houthi attacks raise fears of wider Middle East conflict and more global economic damage
item.description: The Iran-backed group in Yemen has threatened to target Saudi vessels in a vital shipping route.
